{{Quote|No, I was hungry. I went back to the mess.|Punch states his alibi|audio=Punch-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
'''Punch''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served as a member of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was part of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led detachment of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] sent to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]]. Punch aided his [[Platoon/Legends|unit]] in searching the planet for a strategic ambush site, but the Confederacy thwarted the Republic's planned ambush. After the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] returned to the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Republic base]], Punch and fellow [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Sketch/Legends|Sketch]] went to the mess hall. When [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] interrogated the members of Slick's platoon to root out a possible Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]], Punch and Sketch served as each other's alibis. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick himself was later outed as the turncoat and was apprehended.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Right away?''"<br />"''Oh yeah.''"<br />"''Anyone with you?''"<br />"''Sketch, sir.|Rex verifies Punch's alibi|audio=PunchAlibi-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] nicknamed Punch<ref name="TCWCE" /> was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="DB clone troopers" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he joined [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]].<ref name="Official Episode Guide: Season 1" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in the seventh [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the war,<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref><ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Punch was dispatched with a contingent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]]&mdash;led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Once the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] had set up a [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|base]] on the world, Slick's [[Platoon/Legends|unit]] reconnoitered the planet for an appropriate site from which to ambush the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], eventually finding a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|double-towered business center]]. En route back to the Republic base, the platoon came across a detachment of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] that were attempting to clear a major boulevard of [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. When the enemy [[Droid/Legends|droids]] discovered a crippled Christophsian and contemplated [[Death/Legends|killing]] him, the clones intervened and eliminated the droids before returning to base.<ref name="Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref>

[[File:SketchPunchalibi.png|thumb|left|240px|Punch and Sketch served as each other's alibis.]]
[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick's platoon was stationed in the business complex's south-facing tower with [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], while Skywalker and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were based with their [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the parallel north tower. As the Republic forces prepared to attack the Confederate droids below, the advancing column of droids unexpectedly split in two, and battle droids thereafter reached the south tower to [[Ground warfare/Legends|attack]] the clones. Skywalker and his men arrived in the south tower to reinforce Kenobi's group, and they took a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to the roof of the tower, where they retreated from the battlefield aboard [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

After returning to the Republic base, Punch and fellow [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Sketch/Legends|Sketch]] went to the mess hall. As part of an investigation regarding a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] amongst their ranks, Cody and Rex tracked an irregular wavelength in external communications to Slick's [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], leading them to suspect that a member of the platoon was the traitor. Hence, the two [[Officer/Legends|officers]] called the platoon back to its quarters to interrogate them one by one on their whereabouts earlier that evening. Punch and Sketch served as each other's alibis, but trooper [[Chopper (clone trooper)/Legends|Chopper]] was initially believed to be the spy, since he lied and claimed he had been in the mess hall with them. However, Slick was eventually revealed to be the spy before he escaped and [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the Republic's [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]], and weapons depot. When Gus spotted Slick running into the base's command center, Rex and Cody dispatched Slick's platoon to secure the perimeter while they proceeded to the command center. Rex and Cody thereafter managed to apprehend Slick.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Slickssquad.png|thumb|right|250px|Punch and the others discover Slick's treachery.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Punch had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], tan skin, and stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="TCWCE" /> He was good friends with Sketch,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> and they frequented the mess hall at the Christophsis base to the point that it became a habit.<ref name="TCWCE" /> As a result, they were able to verify each other's claims about being in the mess hall during Rex and Cody's interrogation. Later, Punch was visibly shocked when his own sergeant, Slick, was exposed as the Republic traitor.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Punch kept his soul patch goatee immaculately tidy. He was talented in combat, and his [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] saw considerable use on Christophsis.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Punch first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shadowed|''Shadowed'']] and went on to appear in "[[The Hidden Enemy]]," the episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]]' [[2008]]&ndash;[[2009]] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] that the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] led into. In the episode, Punch was portrayed by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voiced all of the series' clone trooper characters.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" />
